task: T-DY2 stage 1: robust readout training, M0 readout-only (DYNAMICS_SOLUTIONS_PLAN.md DY2; S1 WP1, Gate 1)
declared: 2026-10-20, before any T-DY2 run; families F14.DY.robust, F14.DY.robust.secondary, F14.DY.robust.descriptive

training.trainer: studies/brain-supplement-v2/code/replicate_training.py --model remote-dynamic-M0-head_only --replicate r --perturb <condition> (the frozen memory.worker and training_step; X1 replicate definition: timing order seed 1000+r, readout jitter 0.1 SD seed 2000+r; the frozen wall-clock segments 1200/2400/4800 s)

state_dependence.lesion: studies/brain-pathology-v1/runs/regime-b-lesions/C01-dose0.5.json (regime B, C01 dose 0.5: -1.61 mV on every cell)

training.perturbations: dy2_perturbation.py: input noise = Poisson spikes on the 3,200 visual input cells from every reset; membrane noise = N(0, s^2) per ms on non-refractory cells, stationary SD membrane_sd_mv; excitability = uniform threshold offset theta ~ N(0, threshold_sd_mv^2) per episode
training.acceptance: learned = all 18 trained histories solved and all probes correct unperturbed and under both acceptance draws (noise seeds crc32(dy2-accept|<condition>|d<k>), theta -sigma and +sigma); the verification is the frozen unperturbed one
training.clock: under a training condition the worker's segment clock runs at 1/3 of real time (dy2_perturbation.ScaledClock), as the merged assessment runs the frozen assessment three times; real seconds are recorded in replicate.json

evaluation.script: studies/brain-pathology-v1/code/dy2_evaluate.py, one job per model, frozen memory.assess

models.dy2: the 45 healthy and 5 C01-trained T-DY2 runs

healthy_panel.removal: 15 cell sets of the dose series (shares 0.0002-0.005, 3 draws each)
healthy_panel.perturbations: both held-out draws of every condition at the trained timings; of the model's own training condition at all 35

evaluation.lesion_panel: as-trained (full; must reproduce verification), mechanism, th0.5 held-out draws on the lesion, restored (lesion removed; full)

measures.net_use: (cue pairs both solved - pairs none solved) / pairs, per timing set: trained 9 pairs, untrained 26 (analyze_campaign.classes); lock = trained - untrained
measures.ed50_c01: the shift magnitude at which trained net use first falls to <= 0.5 along shifts -3e-5 ... -3.22 mV (as-trained at 0), log-linear interpolation between grid points; censored at 3e-5 (already <= 0.5) and 3.22 (never); 0, the lowest rank, for models whose as-trained trained net use is <= 0.5 (no memory to lose); the geometric-mean ratios use the models with ED50 > 0
measures.ed50_removal: the same over the removal shares 0.0002-0.005, net use averaged over the 3 draws per share
measures.own_perturbation: trained net use averaged over the two held-out draws of the condition the model trained under (for X1, of each condition in turn); for T-DY2 models also untrained net use and the lock under them (descriptive)
measures.restoration_loss: trained net use as-trained (lesion on) - restored (C01-trained models)
measures.mechanism: drop in net use at the prefix-0 trained timings from as-trained to adaptation cleared, and to the opposite-cue swap, at decision onset
measures.cost: updates and training seconds to the end of training (result.json)

tests.primary: F14.DY.robust (Holm, 10 tests): per condition, C01 ED50 of its 5 replicates > X1 r0-r9 (exact one-sided Mann-Whitney over all C(15, 5) splits, mid-ranks for ties and censored values); state dependence: restoration loss of the C01 + th0.5 replicates < regime B C01 dose 0.5 readout-only r1-r6 (exact one-sided Mann-Whitney)
tests.secondary: F14.DY.robust.secondary (BH, 45 tests): per condition vs X1 r0-r9, exact Mann-Whitney: trained net use (two-sided), untrained net use (two-sided), own-perturbation trained net use (greater), removal ED50 (greater), updates (two-sided)
tests.descriptive: F14.DY.robust.descriptive: the S1 Gate 1 criterion per condition (own-perturbation trained net use > 0 in >= 4 of 5 replicates, and the mechanism retained: mean adaptation-clear drop and mean swap drop each at least half of X1's); ED50 ratio (geometric means, condition / X1) with a bootstrap 95% interval (10,000 resamples within groups, seed 20261020); outcomes, updates, seconds; the full perturbation panel
tests.reading: DYNAMICS_SOLUTIONS_PLAN.md section 3: robust = memory and mechanism persist (Gate 1 criterion), ED50 ratio >= 10 and the primary ED50 test significant, state dependence smaller (test 10)

stage_2: S1 readout-only (planned as M0 and S1): deferred, to be declared by amendment before any S1 run. Under the frozen wall-clock segments, S1's sequential assessment (about 30 s) run three times per assessment would leave fewer updates than S1 needed unperturbed (about 300 in about 3,000 s), so a failure would reflect the clock rather than robustness
limitations: the frozen protocol stops on wall-clock segments, so slower perturbed updates (no feature cache, three assessments, per-ms membrane noise) leave fewer updates per segment than X1 had; updates and seconds are reported
the acceptance draws are fixed; the held-out panel uses other seeds and the quartile thresholds
5 replicates per condition; the exact tests use all 10 X1 replicates
